methodology: Fresh canister per case/trial. Fill descending unique priorities outside measurement in bounded update chunks. All queues implement minimum-first behavior; Core PriorityQueue comparator is reversed. Core/fast Map use external key handles; plugin uses native handles. Four forced GC increments precede snapshots. Raw performanceCounter(0) and allocation/reclaimed deltas cover only measured loop including adapter/dispatch overhead, excluding reply and end-of-message GC. Heap snapshots are separate post-GC observations; Wasm memory is highwater and does not imply retained objects. Sorted drain verifies exact remaining count/value sum after each operation.
